_comment: Curated SuperVaultCounsel fleet configuration - the source of truth for 'all strategies' (NOT the full aggregator registry, which includes third-party/test vaults). Per environment: 'defaults' (operator Safe, veto registry, deviation bounds) plus per-chain arrays of per-strategy entries. Every entry may override any default (operator / vetoRegistry / minDeviationThreshold / maxDeviationThreshold) - omitted fields fall back to the environment defaults. Every listed strategy is validated against the on-chain aggregator registry at run time. If a chain's list is EMPTY, runAll falls back to the full on-chain registry using the defaults (intended for staging/test environments only).
_operatorNote: prod defaults.operator MUST be set to the real operator Safe before any prod BROADCAST (simulate works with a placeholder; address(0) reverts only on broadcast). Per-strategy operator overrides let partner fleets (e.g. Bizantine on Flare) use a different Safe.
_vetoRegistryNote: address(0) = veto authority defaults to SuperGovernor.isGuardian; set per-strategy to a custom IVetoRegistry (e.g. Newton attestation shim) to plug per-instance veto authority.

_entryFormat.label: optional human-readable name (ignored by scripts)
_entryFormat.operator: OPTIONAL override - operator Safe for this strategy only; omitted or 0x0 falls back to defaults.operator
_entryFormat.vetoRegistry: OPTIONAL override - IVetoRegistry for this strategy only (e.g. Newton shim); omitted or 0x0 falls back to defaults.vetoRegistry
_entryFormat.minDeviationThreshold: OPTIONAL override; omitted falls back to defaults
_entryFormat.maxDeviationThreshold: OPTIONAL override; omitted falls back to defaults
